text: GRIFFIN CORE SOLUTIONS SL (CIF B06937767) has its registered office at Autovía de la Albufera km 323, Madrid, and since 30 September 2025 has been managed by two joint administrators (administradores solidarios), Alejandro Molina Sanchez and Sergio Molina Sanchez, who were also its sole administrator from its incorporation on 8 July 2021.
short: Griffin Core Solutions S.L. is managed by Alejandro and Sergio Molina Sanchez.
